title: Hosted API evaluation — quick intro & sandbox access
text:
Hosted API evaluation — quick intro & sandbox access

["From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@tilecraft.ai>
To: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T08:12:00+00:00
Subject: Quick question after sign-up: sandbox + short demo?

Hi Mina,

I signed up for the Hosted API sandbox this morning (Tilecraft AI) and got the self-serve credits — thanks! I wanted to check whether you offer a brief call to run through: 1) best practices for low-latency inference, 2) a quick token onboarding (we're EU-based and care about regional routing), and 3) a short walkthrough of the console for embeddings and chat.

We have a couple of engineers available next week mornings (Europe time). If there's a 30-minute slot and someone who can show the sandbox + small workload tips, that would be ideal.

Thanks—
Sofia
Co-founder, Tilecraft AI
sofia.ramos@tilecraft.ai
+44 7700 900111", 'From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@tilecraft.ai>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T09:03:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Quick question after sign-up: sandbox + short demo?

Hi Sofia—great to meet you and welcome to Redwood!

Thanks for signing up and for the quick context. We can definitely do a 30-minute live walkthrough focused on EU routing, low-latency patterns, and the Hosted API sandbox. A couple of proposed windows (GMT):
- Tue Nov 17, 09:00–09:30
- Tue Nov 17, 10:30–11:00
- Wed Nov 18, 08:30–09:00

If none of those work, say what morning window you prefer and we’ll stitch something in.

I’ve included Diego (SDR) to help lock the calendar and provision a short-lived sandbox invite and a pre-demo API key (secure link). I can also attach a one-page quickstart — small checklist to try before we hop on.

Attached: sandbox-invite.txt (token instructions) and sandbox-quickstart.pdf (short prework).

Best,
Mina Haddad
Growth — Hosted API (PLG)
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Office: +1 415 555 0147', 'From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@tilecraft.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T09:27:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Quick question after sign-up: sandbox + short demo?

Thanks Mina — the Tue windows look good. Quick ask before we lock: our engineering lead (based in Lisbon) prefers earlier mornings and would like to start as early as 08:00 GMT if possible. Also, is it possible to get the pre-demo API key provisioned now so we can validate a small batch locally (we have a 10k token test set)?

If 08:00 on Wed Nov 18 works, that would be ideal. If not, we can take Tue Nov 17 at 09:00.

Cheers,
Sofia

> Hi Sofia—great to meet you and welcome to Redwood!
> 
> Thanks for signing up and for the quick context. We can definitely do a 30-minute live walkthrough focused on EU routing, low-latency patterns, and the Hosted API sandbox...', 'From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@tilecraft.ai>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T11:22:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Quick question after sign-up: sandbox + short demo? — scheduling + token steps

Hi Sofia — thanks for the quick reply and for flagging the 08:00 preference. We can do Wed Nov 18 at 08:00–08:30 GMT. I’ve penciled that in tentatively.

Two quick notes on the API key you asked for:
- For security we provision time-limited test keys via an expiring secure link (no key in email). I’ll generate that once the slot is confirmed.
- We can increase the test rate to cover a 10k token run; please confirm the dataset size so we can bump the sandbox quota for that short window.

Ben (CC) — would you mind preparing a short comment in the meeting on recommended quantization and batching parameters for a 100–500ms p99 target on A100-class infra? A 3–5 minute run-through would be perfect.

If Wed at 08:00 is confirmed by Sofia, I’ll send calendar invites and the secure key link.

Cheers,
Diego
SDR, Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood.ai', 'From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@tilecraft.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T15:03:00+00:00
Subject: Re: Quick question after sign-up: sandbox + short demo? — scheduling + token steps

Confirmed for Wed Nov 18, 08:00–08:30 GMT. I’ll be on the call and will prepare a 4-slide runbook:
- quick latency knobs (batching/kv/cache)
- quantization tradeoffs for cost vs quality
- small checklist to hit p99 targets
- post-demo follow-up: eval prompt set + suggested model variants

Diego — for the immediate ask, I’ve uploaded a temporary provisioning script to the shared drive (link below) and will generate the secure key once the invite is accepted (we avoid sending keys in threads). Attached the sandbox-quickstart.pdf referenced earlier.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-assets

Sofia — see you Wed at 08:00 GMT. If anything changes just reply and Diego will reassign.

Best,
Ben Carter
Platform Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
